title: CSV export times out on large reports
content: Exports with more than 10,000 rows can time out in the browser. Workaround: open Reports > Scheduled exports, schedule the export, and download the file from the email link. A permanent fix is tracked as issue 1 in the Globomantics issue tracker.

title: Unlock an administrator account
content: After five failed sign-ins, an administrator account locks for 30 minutes. Another administrator can unlock it right away under Admin > Users > Locked accounts.

title: Set up email integration
content: Open Settings > Integrations > Email, choose your email provider, and sign in with the mailbox you want to sync. The first sync starts within 15 minutes.

title: Email sync stopped after a password change
content: Email sync stops when the mailbox password changes. Fix: open Settings > Integrations > Email, click Reconnect, and sign in with the new password. Version 5.2.1 and later show a warning when this happens.

title: SLA report shows times in the wrong time zone
content: The SLA report shows response times in UTC instead of the account time zone. Workaround: export the report and convert the times in a spreadsheet. This is tracked as issue 3 in the Globomantics issue tracker.

title: Customers do not receive ticket notification emails
content: Check Admin > Notifications and confirm that the Ticket updates rule is turned on. Then ask the customer to add support@globomantics.com to their safe senders list.
